title: DOT-01: GAO-21-310 Recommendation 1 implementation artifact and milestone record
summary: GAO-21-310 Recommendation 1 remains Open. Its normalized follow-through state is No conforming artifact reported; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Current GAO status: Open; status period: April 2026.
Normalized implementation stage: No conforming artifact reported.
Response artifact: Quantitative mission-critical skill-gap assessment. FAA reported that the assessment was on hold because of reorganization and provided no completion schedule.
Artifact availability: No completed assessment reported.
Named milestone: None stated; milestone state: No scheduled completion.
GAO review state: No conforming artifact reported.
Remaining gap: A quantitative assessment covering all critical skills and mission-critical occupations.

Continuation rule: Recheck when FAA resumes and completes the assessment or GAO changes status. Preserve DOT-01 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves DOT-01 as the parent crosswalk.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
